4: ItemHandlers::CanUseInBattle.add(:GUARDSPEC, proc { |item, pokemon, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages|
5:   if !battler || battler.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Mist] > 0
6:     scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It won't have any effect.")) if showMessages
7:     next false
8:   end
9:   next true
10: })

12: ItemHandlers::CanUseInBattle.add(:POKEDOLL, proc { |item, pokemon, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages|
13:   if !battle.wildBattle?
14:     if showMessages
15:       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("Oak's words echoed... There's a time and place for everything! But not now."))
16:     end
17:     next false
18:   end
19:   if !battle.canRun
20:     scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("You can't escape!")) if showMessages
21:     next false
22:   end
23:   next true
24: })

26: ItemHandlers::CanUseInBattle.copy(:POKEDOLL, :FLUFFYTAIL, :POKETOY)

28: ItemHandlers::CanUseInBattle.addIf(:poke_balls,
29:   proc { |item| GameData::Item.get(item).is_poke_ball? },
30:   proc { |item, pokemon, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages|
31:     if battle.pbPlayer.party_full? && $PokemonStorage.full?
32:       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("There is no room left in the PC!")) if showMessages
33:       next false
34:     end
35:     if battle.disablePokeBalls
36:       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("You can't throw a Poké Ball!")) if showMessages
37:       next false
38:     end
39:     # NOTE: Using a Poké Ball consumes all your actions for the round. The code
40:     #       below is one half of making this happen; the other half is in def
41:     #       pbItemUsesAllActions?.
42:     if !firstAction
43:       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's impossible to aim without being focused!")) if showMessages
44:       next false
45:     end
46:     if battler.semiInvulnerable?
47:       scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's no good! It's impossible to aim at a Pokémon that's not in sight!")) if showMessages
48:       next false
49:     end
50:     # NOTE: The code below stops you from throwing a Poké Ball if there is more
51:     #       than one unfainted opposing Pokémon. (Snag Balls can be thrown in
52:     #       this case, but only in trainer battles, and the trainer will deflect
53:     #       them if they are trying to catch a non-Shadow Pokémon.)
54:     if battle.pbOpposingBattlerCount > 1 && !(GameData::Item.get(item).is_snag_ball? && battle.trainerBattle?)
55:       if battle.pbOpposingBattlerCount == 2
56:         scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's no good! It's impossible to aim when there are two Pokémon!")) if showMessages
57:       elsif showMessages
58:         scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's no good! It's impossible to aim when there is more than one Pokémon!"))
59:       end
60:       next false
61:     end
62:     next true
63:   }
64: )

167: ItemHandlers::CanUseInBattle.add(:ELIXIR, proc { |item, pokemon, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages|
168:   if !pokemon.able?
169:     scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It won't have any effect.")) if showMessages
170:     next false
171:   end
172:   canRestore = false
173:   pokemon.moves.each do |m|
174:     next if m.id == 0
175:     next if m.total_pp <= 0 || m.pp == m.total_pp
176:     canRestore = true
177:     break
178:   end
179:   if !canRestore
180:     scene.pbDisplay(_INTL("It won't have any effect.")) if showMessages
181:     next false
182:   end
183:   next true
184: })

298: #===============================================================================
299: # UseInBattle handlers
300: # For items used directly or on an opposing battler
301: #===============================================================================
302: ItemHandlers::UseInBattle.add(:GUARDSPEC, proc { |item, battler, battle|
303:   battler.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Mist] = 5
304:   battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} became shrouded in mist!", battler.pbTeam))
305:   battler.pokemon.changeHappiness("battleitem")
306: })
